status: Accepted design. The first workspace shell is implemented and verified in the private hosted candidate. This map does not report CI, merge, full issue 38 or release status

modules.name: Workspace shell
modules.purpose: One selected project conversation with optional panels
modules.owns: Layout, focus, panel selection and visibility. Durable data stays with its owner.
modules.swap: Replace a renderer or panel without remounting an active conversation.

modules.name: Projects and roots
modules.purpose: Stable project identity and authorized folders
modules.owns: Project IDs, root bindings and revisions. A mutable path is not identity.
modules.swap: Replace a root or VCS observation adapter while preserving IDs and current grants.

modules.name: Conversations and continuity
modules.purpose: Reopen several project conversations and link history across harnesses
modules.owns: References to Native threads, Code runs and harness sessions, plus proposed linkage metadata.
modules.swap: Replace transcript presentation or add an adapter without rewriting retained history.

modules.name: Harness adapters
modules.purpose: Discover supported installed CLIs and their models
modules.owns: Capability and readiness observations. Native owns sessions, events and opaque resume state.
modules.swap: Add a registered adapter, model probe and compatibility evidence. No UI engine-name switch.

modules.name: Authority and approvals
modules.purpose: Make effects explicit, scoped and revocable
modules.owns: Actor/project grant validation, deterministic policy, and exact native action-request binding. The runtime retains originating approval state and lifecycle.
modules.swap: Adapters cannot widen permissions or turn unknown capability into approval.

modules.name: Files and documents
modules.purpose: Browse, read, edit, save and reconcile real files
modules.owns: Project files own bytes. Existing draft state owns unsaved edits and base versions.
modules.swap: Replace the editor or Markdown renderer without replacing save/conflict rules.

modules.name: Workspace operations
modules.purpose: Create, adopt and run the original Vivary commands
modules.owns: Original workspace files, operation plans, policy results and receipts.
modules.swap: Replace transport or packaging while retaining ten-verb behavior and receipt meanings.

modules.name: Search and file memory
modules.purpose: Find files, history and sourced project knowledge
modules.owns: Original files and Native history remain truth. Optional indexes are projections.
modules.swap: Replace an index or retrieval provider without losing source references or private exclusions.

modules.name: Plans and task sources
modules.purpose: Inspect plans, dependencies and approved work
modules.owns: Selected task source owns tasks. Native/local plan owner retains revisions and feedback.
modules.swap: Swap tracker or plan view while preserving external IDs and exact revision binding.

modules.name: Workers and review
modules.purpose: Run bounded work, verify candidates and prepare handoffs
modules.owns: Native owns task/run lifecycle. Vivary owns workflow acceptance and candidate references.
modules.swap: Replace worker strategy without treating a model response as verified completion.

modules.name: Version control and hosts
modules.purpose: Observe checkouts and integrate reviewed changes
modules.owns: VCS and selected repository/task hosts own their records. No-VCS folders remain supported.
modules.swap: Change VCS or host adapter independently from project, harness and task-source choice.

modules.name: Research and learning
modules.purpose: Develop sourced work and review lessons
modules.owns: Authored findings and learning proposals retain sources and scope. Models handle interpretation.
modules.swap: Replace research strategies or Brain connection without making them mandatory.

modules.name: Intake and automation
modules.purpose: Route inputs and perform bounded scheduled work
modules.owns: Native owns scheduling and messaging. Vivary owns routing, deduplication and bounded policies.
modules.swap: Swap configured intake/scheduler adapters. New schedules and outbound effects need authority.

modules.name: Host and desktop
modules.purpose: Run locally or connect to an authenticated private instance
modules.owns: The host owns files, credentials and processes. Clients own presentation.
modules.swap: Upgrade the packaged runtime or client independently with versioned compatibility checks.

modules.name: Distribution and discovery
modules.purpose: Publish truthful artifacts and supported protocols
modules.owns: Release manifests and implemented protocol contracts. Website is a separate repository.
modules.swap: Add a transport over implemented actions without adding bypass permissions or publishing placeholders.

modules.name: Evidence and contributor help
modules.purpose: Make behavior, limits and implementation context inspectable
modules.owns: Source-linked evidence, usage observations, documentation and acceptance records.
modules.swap: Replace visual reports while preserving actual results and unknown measurements.

actions.name: Open project workspace
actions.result: Restore requested selection and conversation frame. No file auto-opens
actions.recovery: Unavailable target remains selected with Retry

actions.name: Open or close project navigation
actions.result: Change layout only. Preserve active run and drafts
actions.recovery: Focus returns to toggle

actions.name: Open project context
actions.result: Show compact host, root, VCS and readiness metadata
actions.recovery: Unknown facts remain unknown

actions.name: Open a requested panel
actions.result: Keep the same conversation mounted
actions.recovery: Unsupported integration explains availability

actions.name: Resize a panel
actions.result: Pointer and keyboard change bounded width
actions.recovery: Narrow view switches to focused panel

actions.name: Maximize or restore a panel
actions.result: Preserve previous layout and conversation
actions.recovery: Escape or Restore returns focus

actions.name: Close and reopen a panel
actions.result: Preserve document draft and prior selection
actions.recovery: No hidden process termination

actions.name: Navigate old workspace links
actions.result: Resolve into one canonical workspace with correct project
actions.recovery: Bad link gives scoped recovery

actions.name: Change appearance
actions.result: Persist theme without altering project state
actions.recovery: Failed preference save exposes Retry

actions.name: Register an existing folder
actions.result: Create stable registration without adopting or modifying bytes
actions.recovery: Duplicate or unauthorized root refused

actions.name: List and refresh projects
actions.result: Return only authorized project metadata
actions.recovery: Retain last selection on refresh failure

actions.name: Switch projects
actions.result: Retain drafts and keep runs bound to original project
actions.recovery: Never silently choose a fallback

actions.name: Locate a moved folder
actions.result: Revalidate identity and explicit new binding
actions.recovery: Mismatched or duplicate root needs resolution

actions.name: Retry unavailable folder
actions.result: Recheck access and root without recreating it
actions.recovery: History stays readable if authorization permits

actions.name: Rename project display name
actions.result: Change metadata only. Stable ID and root retained
actions.recovery: Revision conflict preserves requested name

actions.name: Unregister project
actions.result: Preview reference effects. Preserve files and retained history policy
actions.recovery: Active bindings block or require explicit resolution

actions.name: Merge or split project registrations
actions.result: Preview selected resources and preserve origin identities
actions.recovery: No destructive merge or silent transcript reassignment

actions.name: Create conversation
actions.result: Bind one project and runtime with a new durable reference
actions.recovery: Retry cannot create duplicates

actions.name: Reopen conversation
actions.result: Read exact authorized history and pending state
actions.recovery: Removed harness does not erase history

actions.name: Send a message
actions.result: Bind request and context to current project. Start through the selected runtime and surface its native action decisions
actions.recovery: Stale scope prevents launch. A denied native action does not run

actions.name: Continue existing conversation
actions.result: Use native resume only when supported. Expose replay otherwise
actions.recovery: Incompatible resume offers linked conversation

actions.name: Preserve unsent message
actions.result: Scope draft to conversation and survive panel/project changes
actions.recovery: Failed persistence retains visible draft and Retry

actions.name: Select model in same harness
actions.result: Keep conversation only if adapter supports compatible change
actions.recovery: No silent model substitution

actions.name: Select another harness
actions.result: Create linked conversation and retain unsent input. Do not send
actions.recovery: Failure leaves source conversation unchanged

actions.name: Inspect linked history
actions.result: Resolve source events through completed boundary with source authorization
actions.recovery: Revoked/deleted source shows unavailable reference

actions.name: Inspect context supplied to a turn
actions.result: Show exact sources, summaries and omissions actually supplied
actions.recovery: Unknown harness compaction is labeled

actions.name: Rename or archive conversation
actions.result: Change reference metadata. Preserve history and active work
actions.recovery: Archive does not approve, stop or delete

actions.name: Export or import a handoff
actions.result: Preview included data and validate format, scope and provenance
actions.recovery: No credentials or opaque cross-harness state transfer

actions.name: Discover supported harnesses
actions.result: Enumerate registered adapters and bounded installation probes
actions.recovery: Arbitrary unknown executables never auto-run

actions.name: Refresh available models
actions.result: Obtain account-effective list through supported adapter interface
actions.recovery: Unavailable enumeration stays explicit

actions.name: Open harness sign-in or setup
actions.result: Use supported CLI/account flow and re-probe readiness
actions.recovery: No credential copy into source or transcript

actions.name: Register a new harness adapter
actions.result: Validate interface/version/capabilities and installation consent
actions.recovery: Incompatible adapter is unavailable before execution

actions.name: Upgrade or disable an adapter
actions.result: Preserve sessions and pin active execution identity until safe switch
actions.recovery: Incompatible historical sessions remain readable

actions.name: Approve a pending request
actions.result: Authorize exact request, project and revisions once
actions.recovery: Changed input invalidates approval

actions.name: Deny a pending request
actions.result: Deny the exact requested action. An already running native turn may continue within its remaining permissions
actions.recovery: Retry cannot convert denial into approval

actions.name: Stop active work
actions.result: Use recorded ownership to request cancellation even if folder disappears
actions.recovery: Stopping is not stopped until observed

actions.name: Inspect background activity
actions.result: Show project, conversation, state, Stop and pending decision
actions.recovery: Closed panel/browser never hides running work on return

actions.name: Reconnect after host restart
actions.result: Reconcile Native records with observable process state
actions.recovery: Interrupted or uncertain remains explicit. No automatic replay

actions.name: Change authority policy
actions.result: Preview scope and persist revision
actions.recovery: Pending work revalidates. No retrospective permission

actions.name: Revoke remote access
actions.result: Invalidate selected client grant and reconnect rights
actions.recovery: Server enforces revocation. UI alone is insufficient

actions.name: Browse project files
actions.result: List authorized entries and preserve folder navigation
actions.recovery: Private and escaped paths remain excluded

actions.name: Open a file
actions.result: Read formatted Markdown or supported source. No edit by default
actions.recovery: Unsupported or oversized content has safe fallback

actions.name: Enter or leave edit mode
actions.result: Preserve exact source and base version
actions.recovery: Read view never discards unsaved text

actions.name: Save file
actions.result: Revalidate root and version before writing intended bytes
actions.recovery: External edit yields recoverable conflict

actions.name: Rename file
actions.result: Validate one same-folder filename and exclusive destination
actions.recovery: No overwrite. Partial outcome remains explicit

actions.name: Recover or discard draft
actions.result: Show affected draft and explicit choice
actions.recovery: Discard requires intent. Failed save keeps draft

actions.name: Resolve file conflict
actions.result: Compare disk and draft. Create deliberate reconciled version
actions.recovery: No automatic overwrite of external edits

actions.name: Create document or folder
actions.result: Preview target and create within authorized root
actions.recovery: Existing path conflict does not overwrite

actions.name: Move or remove file
actions.result: Show exact paths, references and recovery limits before effect
actions.recovery: No blanket recursive delete or silent draft loss

actions.name: Ask agent about selected file
actions.result: Stage explicit file reference in same conversation
actions.recovery: Viewing a file alone does not submit its content

actions.name: Preview workspace creation
actions.result: Compute exact files, versions, options and conflicts
actions.recovery: Preview creates no files, VCS, account or remote

actions.name: Apply workspace creation
actions.result: Apply approved unchanged plan then register result
actions.recovery: Partial application preserves receipt and recovery

actions.name: Preview adoption
actions.result: Inspect selected existing folder and proposed thin contract
actions.recovery: Preserve existing instructions and tooling

actions.name: Apply adoption
actions.result: Apply approved nonconflicting operations through original owner
actions.recovery: Stale file/root aborts affected apply

actions.name: Choose or reconfigure built-in pattern
actions.result: Preview authored versus generated file roles and selected content
actions.recovery: Never treat a pattern as a mandatory agent persona

actions.name: Select external template
actions.result: Use approved version/source and explicit destination
actions.recovery: Held catalog remains unavailable

actions.name: Run doctor
actions.result: Report actual workspace condition with actionable results
actions.recovery: Diagnosis does not silently repair files

actions.name: Inspect capabilities
actions.result: Return installed supported operations and limitations
actions.recovery: No advertised capability from unverified dependency

actions.name: Run find
actions.result: Retrieve bounded sourced context through original contract
actions.recovery: Missing source or scope failure remains visible

actions.name: Run check
actions.result: Return original checks and receipt semantics
actions.recovery: No clean result when a check was not run

actions.name: Run decide
actions.result: Use original decision operation and effect classification
actions.recovery: No authority inferred from a generated recommendation

actions.name: Run review
actions.result: Use original review contract and actual evidence
actions.recovery: Model opinion does not become passed verification

actions.name: Run impact
actions.result: Explain contract-defined affected references
actions.recovery: Unknown impact stays unknown

actions.name: Run control
actions.result: Apply only original supported scoped control operation
actions.recovery: Permission/refusal semantics remain unchanged

actions.name: Search file names or text
actions.result: Use bounded exact search and source locations
actions.recovery: Ignore/private policy, size and cancellation apply

actions.name: Open a search match
actions.result: Open exact path and location in requested file panel
actions.recovery: Stale match revalidates current file

actions.name: Search conversation contents
actions.result: Query authorized retained history by content
actions.recovery: No cross-project or revoked-source disclosure

actions.name: Save sourced project memory
actions.result: Write selected fact and provenance through file contract
actions.recovery: No automatic promotion to shared knowledge

actions.name: Recall memory in a new conversation
actions.result: Retrieve current scoped sources and disclose supplied context
actions.recovery: Brain-off path works

actions.name: Correct or forget active memory
actions.result: Update authoritative source and invalidate managed index references
actions.recovery: Retained transcript/backups are not claimed erased

actions.name: Enable or rebuild semantic index
actions.result: Keep source files authoritative and permit skip/off
actions.recovery: Provider unavailable leaves exact search usable

actions.name: Draft or revise a plan
actions.result: Agent proposes goals, dependencies, acceptance and evidence
actions.recovery: Draft grants no execution permission

actions.name: Compare or approve plan revision
actions.result: Approve exact visible revision with declared scope
actions.recovery: Changed plan requires renewed applicable approval

actions.name: View plan graph or board
actions.result: Project authoritative plan/task references
actions.recovery: Graph view never becomes a competing task store

actions.name: Add or edit task dependency
actions.result: Write selected task source and reject cycles/stale revision
actions.recovery: Source refusal leaves local projection unchanged

actions.name: Move or complete a task
actions.result: Validate source lifecycle and required acceptance evidence
actions.recovery: Dragging to Done cannot fake completion

actions.name: Connect task source
actions.result: Choose supported source and grants. Preserve source IDs
actions.recovery: Skip/off path works without an external tracker

actions.name: Start bounded worker
actions.result: Bind approved task, plan, project, adapter, limits and output contract
actions.recovery: Conflict or missing capability starts nothing

actions.name: Delegate or follow up
actions.result: Use Native tasks and existing approval/budget scope
actions.recovery: No second queue or duplicated task identity

actions.name: Review candidate changes
actions.result: Freeze candidate identity and inspect diff, checks and evidence
actions.recovery: New candidate invalidates prior acceptance

actions.name: Request bounded rework
actions.result: Keep prior evidence and explicit failure reason
actions.recovery: No-progress or budget limit stops the loop

actions.name: Accept or reject candidate
actions.result: Record actual acceptance separately from runtime completion
actions.recovery: Unrun checks cannot pass

actions.name: Prepare handoff
actions.result: Gather facts. Agent updates designated document through conflict-aware write
actions.recovery: Failure keeps previous version and shows Retry

actions.name: Inspect handoff freshness
actions.result: Compare covered revisions/events with subsequent changes
actions.recovery: No background model call just to mark stale

actions.name: Observe VCS state
actions.result: Detect none/Git/Jujutsu only when supported
actions.recovery: No-VCS is normal, not an error

actions.name: Create or select checkout
actions.result: Preview root, branch and isolation binding
actions.recovery: Existing session never silently retargets

actions.name: Commit reviewed changes
actions.result: Bind exact candidate and explicit operation authority
actions.recovery: Dirty or changed candidate requires reconciliation

actions.name: Push or open pull request
actions.result: Use chosen host and exact reviewed source
actions.recovery: No account creation or publication inferred

actions.name: Integrate reviewed candidate
actions.result: Recheck source/target and required approvals/checks
actions.recovery: Conflict retains candidate. Never auto-force

actions.name: Research or compare alternatives
actions.result: Use same conversation with sources, uncertainty and bounded scope
actions.recovery: No invented citations or automatic paid escalation

actions.name: Draft writing or creative material
actions.result: Create user-requested editable artifacts with provenance where relevant
actions.recovery: No new mandatory creative agent or implied media backend

actions.name: Connect optional Brain
actions.result: Select project/shared scope and existing connection
actions.recovery: No automatic cross-project sharing

actions.name: Propose lesson or skill change
actions.result: Produce evidence-backed proposal with named evaluation
actions.recovery: Proposal cannot rewrite its own authority

actions.name: Accept, reject or roll back lesson
actions.result: Review exact change and preserve provenance
actions.recovery: Rollback changes active skill, not historical evidence

actions.name: Inspect signed intake
actions.result: Verify sender, signature, scope and deduplication
actions.recovery: Untrusted content is data, never app authority

actions.name: Route intake to project draft
actions.result: Use explicit routing policy and scoped conversation
actions.recovery: Ambiguous routing waits. No outbound send

actions.name: Send approved reply
actions.result: Bind recipient, content and connection to authority
actions.recovery: Drafting does not grant send permission

actions.name: Enable or change schedule
actions.result: Configure existing Native schedule with explicit activation
actions.recovery: No inferred standing authority

actions.name: Run bounded factory workflow
actions.result: Claim eligible task, run accepted stages, stop on limits
actions.recovery: No progress, conflict or unmet gate stops dispatch

actions.name: Run heartbeat prefilter
actions.result: Use deterministic change detection and no-op suppression
actions.recovery: Unchanged state creates no model work

actions.name: Pause, retry or stop automation
actions.result: Persist desired state using Native owner
actions.recovery: Retry does not replay an uncertain external effect

actions.name: Launch desktop
actions.result: Open bundled app and local host without Vivary signup
actions.recovery: Startup failure has visible logs/recovery

actions.name: Connect remote browser
actions.result: Explicit authenticated client to selected self-hosted instance
actions.recovery: No access to laptop folders through Zo by implication

actions.name: Open live project preview
actions.result: Use supported project-scoped URL and isolated frame
actions.recovery: Untrusted preview cannot access privileged app state

actions.name: Inspect and debug preview
actions.result: Use supported browser tools through selected agent
actions.recovery: Unsupported integration is unavailable, not simulated

actions.name: Close browser or app window
actions.result: Persist drafts and follow declared background/lifecycle policy
actions.recovery: Window closure never invents approval

actions.name: Upgrade or remove app
actions.result: Preview version, state compatibility and data retention
actions.recovery: No implicit deletion of projects or account secrets

actions.name: Prepare distributable
actions.result: Bundle required runtimes, licenses, versions and checksums
actions.recovery: Packaging alone never proves Windows execution

actions.name: Publish accepted artifact or website
actions.result: Require exact release evidence and owner acceptance
actions.recovery: No preview/stub claimed installable

actions.name: Expose implemented local protocol action
actions.result: Project same deterministic action through supported transport
actions.recovery: Transport cannot bypass auth or exact scope

actions.name: Publish protocol or discovery metadata
actions.result: Use verified OpenAPI/MCP/A2A/WebMCP/auth/DNS behavior
actions.recovery: No public endpoint/resource without authority

actions.name: Retire selected legacy item
actions.result: Inventory, preserve and verify exact target first
actions.recovery: Separate deletion/rename authority remains required

actions.name: Inspect run tools, results and usage
actions.result: Display actual Native events with source identity
actions.recovery: Missing usage is unknown, not zero

actions.name: Open contextual help
actions.result: Load bounded feature/source/contract/verification route
actions.recovery: Help cannot claim an unsupported feature ready

actions.name: Preserve or restore approved source
actions.result: Use original preservation manifest and verified restore path
actions.recovery: Dirty history never discarded to simplify migration

actions.name: Run consented pilot
actions.result: Measure defined outcomes on fixed source with bounded authority
actions.recovery: No success-rate claim from synthetic tests

actions.name: Create or edit an optional agent profile
actions.result: Use the existing Native resource/settings owner or intentionally authored project instructions
actions.recovery: No mandatory persona. Profile instructions cannot grant tool permissions

actions.name: Select an optional profile
actions.result: Bind the chosen profile reference and revision to future requested context
actions.recovery: No auto-send, session retargeting or approval transfer

actions.name: Clear an optional profile
actions.result: Remove future profile selection while preserving existing history and drafts
actions.recovery: Previously supplied instructions are not claimed erased

actions.name: Inspect effective instructions
actions.result: Show applicable sources, scopes and profile revision without exposing secrets
actions.recovery: Inherited or unavailable sources remain labeled. Instructions are not authority
